widgetTool.name: qr_widget
widgetTool.description: Emit a QR code for a payment request. The payer scans it with their banking app. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Here is your QR code for the payment.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.
